description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing organization memberships, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting memberships, with associated guards, decorators, and service interactions.

classes.name: OrganizationsMembershipsController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling organization membership operations with endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting memberships, secured with multiple guards and decorators.

methods.name: getAllMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all memberships for a specific organization.

methods.name: createMembership
methods.description: Creates a new membership within an organization.

methods.name: getOrgMembership
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific membership within an organization.

methods.name: deleteMembership
methods.description: Deletes a specific membership from an organization.

methods.name: updateMembership
methods.description: Updates details of a specific organization membership.
